findings.motion: Assembly floor: third reading, AB 1116 passed
findings.note: AB 1116 (Berman), voter registration, would let people register online without a California driver license or state ID by giving the last four digits of their Social Security number. Source is CalMatters Digital Democracy, which lists him as Robert Garcia of Assembly District 50. He voted aye.
